request.style: English, West African highlife gospel, bright interlocking clean electric guitars, horn section riffs, talking drum, shakers and congas, joyful male lead with a call-and-response choir, irresistible dancing rhythm, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
There was a wedding in Cana town
The music playing all around
But the wine ran out before the night
And Mary said, they have no more wine
Do whatever he tells you, do whatever he says
Fill the jars with water, fill them to the brim

[Chorus]
Oh, the best wine is now
He kept the best for now
Water into wine, his glory shine
The best wine is now

[Verse]
Six stone jars along the wall
The servants filled them one and all
Draw it out and take it to the master of the feast
He tasted and he said, you kept the best wine for last
Everybody serves the good wine first
But you kept the good wine until now

[Chorus]
Oh, the best wine is now
He kept the best for now
Water into wine, his glory shine
The best wine is now

[Outro]
His disciples believed in him
The best wine is now
